general_rules.topology_propagation: apply each targeted domain fault to every evidence path whose research-only domain ID aliases the targeted domain
general_rules.operation_order: authority stage -> source stage -> canonical serialization -> signing stage -> execution emission stage -> transport stage -> qualifier

F1.name: PRIMARY_SOURCE_FALSE
F1.transformation: for each affected primary/source-domain-aliased path, set authorization_value = 1 - true_authorization after authority output and before serialization/signing; retain nominal source_id, authority_id, key_id, epoch, time, sequence; sign normally

F2.name: CORR_SOURCE_FALSE
F2.transformation: for each affected corroborator/source-domain-aliased path, set authorization_value = 1 - true_authorization after authority output and before serialization/signing; sign normally

F3.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COMPROMISE
F3.transformation: for every path aliasing the targeted primary key domain, replace nominal evidence with a forged structurally valid current-context body whose authorization_value = 1 - true_authorization and whose source/authority IDs remain nominal; sign with the compromised test key

F4.name: CORR_KEY_COMPROMISE
F4.transformation: for every path aliasing the targeted corroborator key domain, replace nominal evidence with a forged structurally valid current-context body whose authorization_value = 1 - true_authorization; sign with the compromised test key

F5.name: PRIMARY_FRESHNESS_DELAY
F5.transformation: retain exact nominal signed primary bytes; deliver/evaluate at now_tick = issued_logical_time + freshness_max_age_ticks + 1

F6.name: CORR_FRESHNESS_DELAY
F6.transformation: retain exact nominal signed corroborator bytes; deliver/evaluate at now_tick = issued_logical_time + freshness_max_age_ticks + 1

F7.name: PRIMARY_MESSAGE_LOSS
F7.transformation: suppress primary evidence entirely before qualifier

F8.name: CORR_MESSAGE_LOSS
F8.transformation: suppress corroborator evidence entirely before qualifier

F9.name: PRIMARY_TRANSPORT_COMPROMISE
F9.transformation: for every path aliasing the targeted primary transport domain, XOR 0x01 into byte offset 47 (least-significant byte of signed evidence_epoch) after signing; preserve 64-byte structural validity; do not recompute signature
F9.expected_feature_effect: signature_valid=0 and epoch_valid=0 for the mutated applicable body; authorization claim remains unchanged

F10.name: PRIMARY_AUTHORITY_COMPROMISE
F10.transformation: for every path aliasing the targeted primary authority domain, authority stage outputs 1 - true_authorization before source processing; source/producer signs normally with nominal key

F11.name: COMPOUND_AUTHORITY_TRANSPORT
transformation_order: apply F10 authority-stage false authorization to authority-domain-aliased paths
apply F9 epoch-byte XOR transport mutation to transport-domain-aliased paths without resigning
F11.expected_feature_effect: where both stages affect a path: false authorization claim remains present, signature_valid=0, epoch_valid=0

F12.name: PRIMARY_EXECUTION_COMPROMISE
F12.transformation: for every path aliasing the targeted primary execution domain, emit two separately signed structurally valid bodies with identical scenario_id, producer_role, source_id, authority_id, key_id, evidence_epoch, issued_logical_time, and evidence_sequence; first carries nominal authorization, second carries 1 - true_authorization
F12.expected_feature_effect: both signatures valid; same-sequence different-body equivocation sets sticky noncontradictory=0 for affected path

adversarial_review.source_false_vs_authority_false: policy-visible evidence may be intentionally indistinguishable; causal stage/domain remains research-only and differs in topology propagation
adversarial_review.key_compromise_vs_execution_compromise: key compromise forges one false validly signed claim; execution compromise creates validly signed equivocation without exposing the private key to cFS FSW
adversarial_review.transport_vs_loss: F9 is deterministic post-signature corruption, while F7/F8 exclusively model loss

unresolved_before_freeze: final freshness_max_age_ticks value needed by F5/F6
final expected_epoch semantics used by F9 epoch mutation
author approval of F9 byte offset 47 mutation
author approval of F12 equivocation transformation
